## Highlights

Small editing polish on top of the v0.3.1 data-safety release.

## Tab and indentation

- **Tab** inserts a tab, replacing a selection within one line. With a multi-line selection, it indents every selected line.
- **Shift+Tab** removes one tab, or up to four spaces, of indentation from the cursor's line or each selected line.
- Selections keep their direction and cover the same text after indenting. A line where the selection merely ends at its start is left alone.
- Tab still accepts a `[[` link suggestion while the list is open.

## Tab stops

Tabs now line up at tab stops every four cells, instead of always taking four cells. Text after a tab aligns across lines. Wrapping, up/down cursor movement and drawing all follow the same stops, including after wide characters such as CJK and emoji.

## Downloads and validation

Archives are available for **Linux and Windows**, on **amd64 and arm64**, with `SHA256SUMS`.

New tests cover tab-stop drawing and measurement, wrapping a tab that does not fit, vertical movement across tabs, and Tab/Shift+Tab with and without selections (including reversed selections and no-op outdents).
